youtube.description:
4 Kiro hook gotchas nobody warns you about

Four Kiro hook gotchas that save you an hour.

1. Agent only - File triggers fire on agent changes, not your saves.
2. No manual hooks - You can't create new manual hooks in the IDE.
3. Slash command trick - Use a manual steering file as a slash command.
4. More triggers - There are more triggers than file events.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types/
